from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents one legal judgment document and its assigned cause of action."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, e.g. '《判决文书1》'")
    cause_of_action: Literal[
        '行政行为-行政处罚',
        '破坏社会主义市场经济秩序罪',
        '知识产权与竞争纠纷',
        '适用特殊程序案件案由',
        '婚姻家庭纠纷',
        '行政行为-行政确认',
        '行政行为-行政征收',
        '行政主体-司法行政管理（司法行政）'
    ] = Field(description="The specific cause of action category for this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument] = Field(description="List of parsed legal judgment documents with their titles and categories")
